necessary_context.content: F_d(R,L) consists of globally geodesically convex, globally L-Lipschitz f:H^d->R on curvature -1 hyperbolic space with a global minimizer in the closed ball centered at known o of radius R. A legal fixed Oracle returns exact f(x) and g_f(x) satisfying f(y)>=f(x)+<g_f(x),log_x y> for every ambient y. Algorithms know o,d,R,L,epsilon, may query anywhere and output an unqueried point; exact geometry/internal computation is free. Q*=sup_{d>=2}Q*_d.
necessary_context.name: Function class and charged Oracle

necessary_context.content: H^d={x:<x,x>_L=-1,x_0>0}; <x,y>_L=-x_0y_0+sum_{j=1}^d x_jy_j. A public subspace is V=H^d intersect W with W Lorentz and containing a timelike vector; W perpendicular_L is Euclidean. Compact convex carriers and their supporting normals realize full global subgradients, rather than merely inequalities at sampled points.
necessary_context.name: Hyperboloid and carriers

necessary_context.content: Scaling to curvature -1 is in §3.3, p.6, with g'=k^2g, R=kr, L'=L/k and selected tangent subgradient h'=h/k^2.
